description: This file defines the interface for managing and manipulating 'tree' objects within a git-like repository. It includes structure definitions, function prototypes for parsing and comparing trees, and macros for parsing trees in various contexts.

methods.name: lookup_tree
methods.description: Looks up a tree object within the specified repository using an object ID.

methods.name: parse_tree_buffer
methods.description: Parses a tree object from a given buffer.

methods.name: repo_parse_tree_gently
methods.description: Gently parses a tree object within the repository, optionally suppressing errors if missing.

methods.name: parse_tree_gently
methods.description: Inline macro that calls repo_parse_tree_gently with the current repository.

methods.name: int repo_parse_tree(struct repository * r,struct tree * item)
methods.description: Parses a tree object in the current repository.

methods.name: repo_parse_tree_indirect
methods.description: Parses a tree object referenced indirectly via an object ID, chasing tags and commits.

methods.name: base_name_compare
methods.description: Compares base names of paths considering the mode.

methods.name: df_name_compare
methods.description: Compares directory file names considering the mode.

methods.name: read_tree_at
methods.description: Reads a tree at a specific depth and path, invoking a callback function on each entry.

methods.name: read_tree
methods.description: Reads a tree with a specified path specification and callback.

ctags.name: read_tree_fn_t
ctags.pattern: /^typedef int (*read_tree_fn_t)(const struct object_id *, struct strbuf *, const char *, unsigned /
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const struct object_id *,struct strbuf *,const char *,unsigned int,void *)

ctags.name: repo_parse_tree
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int repo_parse_tree(struct repository *r, struct tree *item)$/
